review.why: Creates and audits 'alternative' and 'X vs Y' pages, with page formats, fair-claim rules and a claim-by-claim check of existing competitive content.
review.summary: Defines four page formats with section order and target keywords, essential sections, a centralized competitor data file and a research process. Its evidence rules say not observed is not absent, claims carry dates, and facts stay apart from motives. An audit marks each claim current, changed, unverifiable or overclaimed.
strengths: Evidence rules protect against false public claims about another company
Refuses to guess the competitor and asks first
Audit output gives replacement wording, public pages first
cautions: Verifying claims needs live access to competitor sites
Templates and data structure are in files not read here
